test_S3PathHandler_open_write: test the S3PathHandler to write string and bytes files to an S3 bucket using open in write mode
test_S3PathHandler_exists_isdir_isfile: test the S3PathHandler exists, isdir, and isfile methods to check S3 paths for files and directories
test_S3PathHandler_copy_and_ls: test the S3PathHandler copy method to duplicate S3 files and ls to list directory contents
test_S3PathHandler_get_local_path: test the S3PathHandler get_local_path method to download and cache S3 files locally with idempotent behavior
test_S3PathHandler_mkdirs_and_rm: test the S3PathHandler mkdirs and rm methods to create and remove S3 directories and files
